# Support

Open a [support question](https://github.com/xmetaads/winregistry/issues/new?template=question.yml)
for usage questions and deployment design. Search existing issues first.

Open a [bug report](https://github.com/xmetaads/winregistry/issues/new?template=bug.yml)
when behavior is reproducibly wrong. Include:

- `regx --version`;
- Windows edition and build;
- whether the shell is elevated;
- the exact command and exit code;
- `regx --self-check --output json`;
- the smallest non-secret input that reproduces the problem.

Do not put vulnerabilities or secrets in an issue. Follow
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and report vulnerabilities privately.

This is a community-maintained project. Security reports have the response
targets in the security policy; ordinary support has no guaranteed response
time.
